episodes.title: Sorry About The Green Vomit On The Floor
episodes.description:
Trick or Treat? Lucky number 13 is hitting the streets early so it makes it in time for Halloween!








Our final episode in the paranormal series is here!!! Though we’re so sad to see spooky season go- we’re ending it with possibly the craziest stories yet! Hosts Margo Rita, Tuesday Addams, and Alexa Pro discuss more paranormal encounters in the evangelical church that can’t be explained! We hope this series helps you feel seen and validated in any similar experiences and continues to open the conversation around the paranormal. HAPPY HALLOWEEN!

episodes.title: Sorry Halloween's Just ACOTAR and Demons
episodes.description:
Ready for more paranormal stories? In this spooky Halloween episode, hosts Margo Rita, Tuesday Addams & Alexa Pro discuss more experiences with the supernatural while still a part of the evangelical church. More church camp trauma, seeing unexplained entities, and "that really happened!" coming your way!

 

Let us know your thoughts on our experiences, and share any of your personal stories with us, too! Be sure to follow us on Instagram and TikTok for more fun content.

episodes.title: Sorry For Telling You About Our Literal Demons (Take 2)
episodes.description:
In this week’s spooky episode, hosts Margo Rita, Tuesday Addams, & Alexa Pro share stories of paranormal experiences during their time in the evangelical church. Each story opens a conversation around what can/cannot be explained & how the paranormal is viewed in the church. It also opens discussion around what we believe now & how our relationships with the supernatural might be different if not influenced by the church. We invite you to share your stories with us! episodes.title: Sorry For Dragging You To Hell On Halloween
episodes.description:
In this episode, we talk about Christian Halloween alternatives that get progressively worse until they're significantly scarier than Halloween itself. Next week, we'll begin our paranormal episodes, so please send us your stories and become a part of the conversation!

We sincerely apologize for the audio issues in this episode. We did our best to fix them, but we weren't aware of them until post-production. We're actively working on fixing the input so that this doesn't happen again! We hope you'll join us for our first Halloween episode anyway.


Trigger Warnings: This episode discusses terrifying depictions of hell which we feel could be considered abusive to force children to go to, emotional abuse and religious coercion. Please listen with discretion.

episodes.title: Sorry For Kissing Dating Goodbye
episodes.description: This week, we dive into one of the most culturally impactful movements in the Evangelical church- Purity Culture. This movement impacted us, our families and friends, and our whole lives while in the church and after leaving. This topic is so vast, we felt it needed 2 episodes. In this episode (part 1), we aim to establish and define the purity culture movement and its impact on the young people in the church. And yep, we included contracts, True Love Waits, and purity rings. In part 2, we'll get more personal and share how it impacted each of us personally, but for now- we hope listening to us talk about it helps you feel seen and know that you're not alone. Please excuse our few audio issues in this episode. Either Tuesday needs a new mic, or we have a ghost. We don't really know. As always, please email us with your thoughts, concerns, topic ideas, personal stories, *prayer requests and praise reports (hallelu--hallelu--halleluuuuuuujah)*! sorry4beinganevangelicalteen@gmail.com instagram.com/sorryiwasevangelicalpod

episodes.title: Sorry For Talking Too Much About Cults: Heaven's Gate (Minisode)
episodes.description: In this episode, we begin our minisode series that's all about cults! Alexa takes us on a journey into the Heaven's Gate cult that found its end in the late 1990s. God's Will, Bo Peep and UFOs? Count us in! Tune in every Sunday for a new episode of Sorry For What I Said When I Was An Evangelical Teenager, where we discuss deconstructing, religious trauma, and growing up in (and ultimately leaving) the evangelical church. Please email us with your comments and stories at: sorry4beinganevangelicalteen@gmail.com instagram.com/sorryiwasevangelicalpod

episodes.title: Sorry For Asking Too Many Questions
episodes.description: In our second episode, we attempt to play 20 Questions. We discuss our history as evangelical teens and experiences with magic, music, style, holidays and childhood amidst religion and religious trauma. During this, we give some insight into our stories and pieces of what led to us deconstructing and becaming ex-vangelical adults. sorry4beinganevangelicalteen@gmail.com instagram.com/sorryiwasevangelicalpod

episodes.title: Sorry We Can't Stop Laughing
episodes.description: In this introductory episode, three Millennial women talk about some of our wildest experiences when we were involved in churches and some key reasons we began to deconstruct and become ex-vangelical. We laugh, we cry (from laughing), we share our crazy stories, and we invite you to join the conversation. Chat with us at sorry4beinganevangelicalteen@gmail.com instagram.com/sorryiwasevangelicalpod
